paragraphs: This policy explains what personal data the Travelo mobile app (the "App") processes, why, for how long, and what rights you have.

sections.heading: 1. Data controller
paragraphs: The controller of your personal data is Kacper Bartłomiejczak, a natural person, Poland ("we", the "Controller").
For anything about personal data, write to: kacperbartlomiejczak@proton.me.
We have not appointed a data protection officer, as we are not required to.

sections.heading: 2.1 Account and sign-in
paragraphs: • Sign-in with Google: your e-mail address and Google account ID, which Google passes to us after you agree on its sign-in screen.
• Sign-in with Discord: your e-mail address and Discord account ID.
• Sign-in with e-mail: the e-mail address we send a 6-digit code to.
• Technical sign-in data: date and time of sign-in, IP address and device information kept in server logs.
We never see or store your Google or Discord password.

sections.heading: 2.2 Profile
paragraphs: • Nickname (unique), chosen interests, an optional profile photo.
• Friend code (6 characters), assigned automatically. Anyone who knows your code can see your nickname and interests and add you to their trip as a friend with an account.

sections.heading: 2.3 Trips
paragraphs: • Trip name, cover photo, flights (airports, dates and times, optionally the flight number), daily budget and currency.

• Friends without an account: the name (or other label) and interests of the people you add to a trip. These people have no account in the App. Only add them if they know you are using their details to plan a shared trip.
• Friends with an account: if you add someone by their friend code, they can see the trip (without changing it) and add their own expenses. You see their nickname and interests.

sections.heading: 2.4 Photos
paragraphs: • Photos you add to a trip, and your profile photo.
• Before uploading, the App downsizes each photo and re-saves it without EXIF metadata, so without GPS location, camera model etc. We keep only the date the photo was taken (to sort photos).
• Photos are kept in private file storage; only people with access to the trip can see them (your profile photo: only you).

sections.heading: 2.5 Expenses
paragraphs: • Name, amount, currency, category and day of the expense, and who paid it (you or a friend on the trip).

sections.heading: 2.6 Discovering places (AI)
paragraphs: • When you use "Discover places", we send Google only the city name and a list of interests. We do not send your nickname, e-mail, photos, friends' names or your device location.
• We keep a count of your requests per day (limit: 5 per day per account) to protect the service from abuse.

sections.heading: 2.7 Data on your phone only
paragraphs: The App keeps a copy of your trips, profile and expenses on your phone so it works without internet, plus your theme and language choice. When you sign out or delete your account, the copy of your data is erased from the phone (theme and language stay).
The App does not use advertising or analytics tools and does not track your location.

sections.heading: 3. Purposes and legal bases
paragraphs: Creating and running your account, sign-in, profile — Art. 6(1)(b) — performance of a contract (the Terms)
Trip planning, photos, expenses, syncing between phone and server — Art. 6(1)(b) — performance of a contract
Processing the details of friends without an account that you enter — Art. 6(1)(f) — legitimate interest: letting you plan a shared trip
Discovering places (city + interests) — Art. 6(1)(b) — performance of a contract
Security, logs, the AI request limit, preventing abuse — Art. 6(1)(f) — legitimate interest: security of the service
Replying to messages, complaints, defending against claims — Art. 6(1)(f) and Art. 6(1)(c) (consumer-law obligations)
Providing data is voluntary, but an account cannot be created without an e-mail address (or a Google/Discord account) and a nickname.
We do not make decisions about you based solely on automated processing that produce legal effects or similarly significantly affect you. AI place recommendations are only suggestions.

sections.heading: 4. Who receives your data
paragraphs: • Supabase Inc. — hosting of the database, sign-in, files and server functions (a processor under a data processing agreement). Data is stored in Ireland (AWS eu-west-1).

• Google — (a) if you sign in with Google: Google, as a separate controller, authenticates you and passes us your e-mail; (b) the Google Places API and the Gemini API receive only the city and interests from a "Discover places" request. The request is sent by our server, not by your phone. We use the paid tier of the Gemini API, where Google does not use requests to train its models.
• Discord Inc. — if you sign in with Discord, as a separate controller.
• Friends with an account whom you add to a trip, or who added you — they see that trip's data (see 2.3).
• Public authorities — only where the law requires it.
We do not sell your data or share it for marketing.

sections.heading: 5. Transfers outside the European Economic Area
paragraphs: Supabase, Google and Discord are US companies. Where data leaves the EEA, this is based on a European Commission adequacy decision (the EU-US Data Privacy Framework) or standard contractual clauses (Art. 46 GDPR). You can get a copy of the safeguards by writing to the address in section 1.

sections.heading: 6. How long we keep data
paragraphs: • Account, profile, trip, photo and expense data — until you delete your account (or earlier, if you delete a given trip, photo or expense).

• When you delete your account, the data is erased from the database and file storage at once. The provider's backups may still contain it for a limited time set by the backup cycle, after which they are overwritten.
• Exception: in other people's trips you belong to, your nickname and your expenses stay as a "friend without an account", because they are part of another person's trip.
• AI request count — for the day it relates to and briefly after.
• Technical logs — for the period set by the hosting provider, usually a few days.
• Correspondence with us — until the matter is closed; for complaints or claims, until the limitation period ends.

sections.heading: 7. Your rights
paragraphs: You have the right to:
• access your data and get a copy,
• rectify your data (you can change your nickname and interests yourself in "Edit profile"),
• erasure,
• restriction of processing,
• data portability,
• object to processing based on legitimate interest,

• lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority — in Poland the President of the Personal Data Protection Office (ul. Stawki 2, 00-193 Warszawa, uodo.gov.pl), or the authority in your EU country of residence.
To use your rights, write to the address in section 1. We reply within one month.
If you were added to someone's trip without an account and want your data removed, write to us or ask the organizer to remove you.

sections.heading: 8. Deleting your account
paragraphs: You can delete your account yourself in the App: Profile → Settings → Delete account (needs internet). This erases your account, profile, profile photo and every trip you organize, with its expenses and photos — also for the friends added to it. You can also ask us by e-mail to delete your account.

sections.heading: 9. Security
paragraphs: Connections are encrypted (HTTPS). Row-level security rules limit access in the database — everyone sees only their own data and the trips they belong to. Photos are in private storage and shown through links valid for one hour. Keys for external services are kept on the server only.

sections.heading: 10. Age
paragraphs: The App is intended for people aged 16 and over.

sections.heading: 11. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We will tell you about significant changes in the App before they take effect. The current version is always available in the App and at this policy's public address.

sections.heading: 1. General
paragraphs: 1. These Terms set the rules for using the Travelo mobile app (the "App") and are the terms of providing services by electronic means.
2. The service provider is Kacper Bartłomiejczak, a natural person, Poland, e-mail: kacperbartlomiejczak@proton.me (the "Provider", "we").
3. The App helps an organizer plan a shared trip with friends: save flights, friends and a budget, add photos and expenses, and discover places with the help of artificial intelligence (AI).
4. Using the App is free of charge.
5. How personal data is processed is described in the Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: 2. Technical requirements
paragraphs: You need a smartphone with a current iOS or Android version, internet access (some features also work offline), and a Google account, a Discord account or an e-mail address.

sections.heading: 3. Account
paragraphs: 1. You need an account to use the App. You create it by signing in with Google, Discord or e-mail and setting up a profile (nickname and interests).
2. The service agreement is concluded when the account is created, for an indefinite period.
3. You can delete your account at any time in the App (Profile → Settings → Delete account) or by asking us by e-mail. This terminates the agreement.
4. Keep the Google account, Discord account or mailbox you sign in with secure.
5. The App is intended for people aged 16 and over.

sections.heading: 4. Rules of use
paragraphs: 1. Use the App lawfully and in line with these Terms.
2. You must not:
• add content that is unlawful, offensive or infringes other people's rights (including other people's photos without consent),
• enter other people's details without their knowledge,
• try to bypass security measures or limits (e.g. the AI request limit) or disrupt the service,
• choose a nickname that impersonates someone else or is offensive.
3. If you break these rules, we may block or delete your account after first asking you to stop (unless the breach is serious). We will tell you by e-mail, with the reason.

sections.heading: 5. Your content
paragraphs: 1. Photos, names, expenses and other data you add remain yours.

2. You grant us a non-exclusive, free licence to store, technically process (e.g. downsize a photo) and display that content to you and the people you share a trip with — only as far as needed for the App to work, for as long as the content is in the App.
3. You are responsible for having the right to the content you add, and for the people whose details you enter (e.g. friends' names and interests) knowing about it.

sections.heading: 6. AI recommendations and place data
paragraphs: 1. "Discover places" suggests places based on Google Places data and the answers of an AI model (Google Gemini).

2. Recommendations are for information only. They may be out of date, incomplete or off the mark. Before visiting, check the opening hours, prices, availability and safety of a place yourself, e.g. on its website or in Google Maps.
3. Recommendations are not professional advice (e.g. medical, legal, financial or safety advice). You decide yourself where to go and what to do.

4. Place data comes from Google Maps Platform ("Google Maps") and is subject to the Google Maps Terms of Service (https://maps.google.com/help/terms_maps/) and the Google Privacy Policy (https://policies.google.com/privacy). Google is not a party to these Terms.
5. The number of AI requests is limited (currently 5 per day per account).

sections.heading: 7. Expenses and budget
paragraphs: The budget and expense features are for private record-keeping. Amounts, totals and balances are calculated from the data you enter and are not financial advice or a settlement document.

sections.heading: 8. Availability
paragraphs: 1. We do our best to keep the App working correctly and without interruption, but we do not guarantee uninterrupted availability. There may be maintenance breaks, outages at providers (e.g. hosting, Google) and bugs.

2. We may develop, change or withdraw features of the App. We will give at least 30 days' notice before withdrawing a significant feature or shutting the App down, so you can keep the information you need.
3. Keep your own copies of important information (e.g. flight confirmations) — the App does not replace travel documents.

sections.heading: 9. Liability
paragraphs: 1. The App is provided free of charge, as it is. To the extent permitted by law, we give no guarantee that it will meet all your expectations.
2. We are not liable for:
• the consequences of decisions made on the basis of AI recommendations or place data (section 6),
• content added by users,
• interruptions and errors at external providers outside our control.

3. This section does not exclude or limit any liability towards a consumer that cannot be excluded or limited under applicable law, in particular for damage caused intentionally and for the conformity of a digital service with the contract under the Polish Consumer Rights Act.

sections.heading: 10. Complaints
paragraphs: 1. Send a complaint (e.g. about the service not conforming with the contract) to kacperbartlomiejczak@proton.me. Describe the problem and give your account e-mail or nickname.
2. We will reply within 14 days of receiving it.

3. As a consumer you may also use out-of-court dispute resolution, e.g. help from a municipal or district consumer ombudsman, or the regional Trade Inspection office (in Poland), or the equivalent bodies in your country.

sections.heading: 11. Changes to the Terms
paragraphs: 1. We may change these Terms for important reasons: changes in the law, changes to the App's features, changes of service providers or security reasons.
2. We will tell you about a change in the App at least 14 days before it takes effect.
3. If you do not accept the changes, you can delete your account before they take effect. Using the App after that date means you accept the new version.

sections.heading: 12. Governing law
paragraphs: 1. These Terms are governed by Polish law. If you are a consumer living in another country, the choice of Polish law does not deprive you of the protection given by the mandatory provisions of the law of your country.
2. Disputes are settled by the courts competent under general rules.
